body: This is the last time `opcodes` is referenced in a generator cycle, so it should be safe to `std::move`.

This might be a potential performance regression. Saving and restoring old static data relies on CoW, so there's no way to reliably not copy it without changing more than we should.

I did the change mostly thinking about non-editor usage, as reloading in general isn't performance-critical, but I don't think this should be any worse than `GDScriptInstance::members` restoration.
At core, `ERR_FAIL_INDEX_V` checks if `p_idx` is lower than 0. While making it `uint32_t` isn't invalid, some compilers don't like we're checking if an unsigned integer is lower than 0.
`continuation_lines` is unused and can be safely removed. Surprised the compiler never caught this.

I don't get this `resize` part. `_restore_old_static_data` has a fixed place in the reload process which is after the compiler did resize and default initialize `static_variables`, no? Ensuring consistent state regarding `static_variables` and `static_variables_indices` is not in the scope of this method IMO.

The `resize` was a safety measure as I was afraid of how `_save_old_static_data` cleared `static_variables` and `_restore_old_static_data` was just assigning values with indexes right after, especially with how a quick look doesn't make it clear `static_variables` is already resized in-between.

After a second look with a rested mind, another allocation is inevitable, so my first performance regression argument is invalid.

```suggestion
		for (const _GDScriptMemberSort &sort : msort) {
```

If we are touching this, we should do it like this, for readability.

Also wanted to link https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111153 before you try to optimize here further.
Shouldn't this be a move then as well?

```suggestion
	LocalVector<ClassRefWithName> weak_subclasses;
```

Or if you care (recall that the initial reserve call will reserve the exact amount, since the growth factor is determined by `current_size * 1.5` with the current impl.)

```suggestion
	LocalVector<ClassRefWithName> weak_subclasses;
	weak_subclasses.reserve(subclasses.size())
```

but this is no hot path as far as I can tell.
I don't even see were values would be added to this. It's either practically useless, or does something very complex. In both cases I think it's best we leave it alone for now.
This vector uses resize + assign. There is zero need for it to calculate a growth rate.
Again, you don't need to handle growth when you have resize + assign.

I'd prefer to stick with `LocalVector` in most cases (where there is no chance of multiple resizes happening).

`LocalVector` is totally fine for local resize+assign, the initial resize will not reserve unnecessary space. I used the tight variant for members, to protect against edge cases with hot-reloading.

The additional arithmetic OP `capacity*1.5` (assuming the compiler can't get rid of it) is a price worth paying for not having to change all of this again if https://chat.godotengine.org/channel/core?msg=t5dkR49u2RXqyTgY3 goes anywhere.
Yeah, because it's public. Apparently it occurred to no compiler vendor, that an unused public var might be a bad thing :facepalm:
`HashMap` doesn't seem to have a `&&` operator.

https://github.com/HolonProduction/godot/blob/645638db91769059ed061450e6b348a7033d4225/core/templates/hash_map.h#L632

Am I missing something?
Wow, somehow I missed it. Might have been a wrong search or something.

Frankly I don't understand what the issue is, because only `p_idx < 0` would be checked (which makes me wonder whether the type of `p_idx` should be changed 🤔). But seeing that this is done like this in other parts of the codebase as well, I guess there is some reason to it.
Well, just realized `ERR_FAIL_UNSIGNED_INDEX_V` exists.
This should only be done if also changing the paramter of `write_set_static_variable`
Same for `write_get_static_variable`

Done + went a little further and changed `GDScript::MemberInfo::index` from `int` to `uint32_t` (as it's passed to `write_(set/get)_static_variable_index`) + any function with an parameter that compares to it.

***Edit***: And also `_GDScriptMemberSort::index`.

Note that if we also want to [change every single index in the GDScript codebase to unsigned](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/compare/master...DeeJayLSP:godot:gdscript-extreme-vegan-edition?expand=1), the diff would skyrocket to over 550 lines (almost half of them just in the VM).
